issue_request: FHIR-18235 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I issue asking to replace the confusing nested if/else bullets under "How to resolve a reference in a Bundle" with a clearer sequence for absolute references, relative [type]/[id] references resolved against a RESTful fullUrl, bundle lookup, external dereference, and failure.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18235 or GF#18235 was found. The Jira comment cites GH#c9067ba302, but that commit is GF#18552 and only added external-reference clarification text, leaving the confusing nested Bundle reference-resolution list intact. A later Zulip thread confirms the reporter and editor recognized that the cited commit did not contain the requested FHIR-18235 change.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml is authoritative current source. FHIR-29271 later reopened the same confusing section and FHIR-31422 refined the same Bundle fullUrl/reference URI-scheme family. Commit e084181ce7efd960c27096be172fcc0d0e845a81 applied those later issues by replacing the old nested list with explicit resolving sections for URNs, absolute references, relative references against a RESTful base, conditional references, canonical references, and failure. Later terminology corrections such as FHIR-50423 preserved that structure.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the FHIR-18235 intent after later applied work: the old ambiguous if/else flow is gone, the relative-to-absolute step is explicit, absolute reference resolution is defined, and failure cases state that the reference has no defined meaning.
